parties.respondent: The State Represented By Deputy Director And Ors.

summary: Enforcement Case Information Report under PMLA 2002; remand to judicial custody; validity of police remand under PMLA; exclusion of hospitalisation period from custody count; Habeas Corpus maintainability; conflicting Division Bench orders; ED's powers to seek police custody; medical custody conditions; Section 19 arrest upheld; Section 17 search validity; judicial custody period calculation; ED custody challenged.
legal_provisions_cited: Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002 s.3; s.4
final_judgment: Habeas Corpus petition maintainability confirmed; ED's power to seek police custody under PMLA upheld; period of hospitalisation excluded from custody count; conflicting Division Bench orders resolved; remand orders validated; appeal disposed based on specific findings.
